spans.s: (II)--a son of संकट. His sons were god- lings, being the presiding deities of fortresses. भा.

(III) (च्)--the land in which the Buddha was born; its people became purified by their devotion to Hari;
1: भा.

. २४; VII. १०. १९.
noted for the sacred गया and the garden park राजगृह, also for the आश्रम of Cyavana. Other sacred spots fit for श्राद्ध offerings were वैकुण्ठ, लोहदण्ड, गृध्रकूटा and शोणक.
2: वा. १०८. ७३-4.
--the mother of बलाहक and seven other sons, all commanders of भण्ड. Br. IV. २४. 6.
